_meta.description: The comment window. Anchored at the NEWEST end: `limit` keeps the most recent comments and `skip_newest` pages back into older ones, which is why the skip key is not called `offset` (the list commands' `offset` counts from the start). `additionalProperties` is false so a new key has to be described here rather than shipping invisible to a client generated from this schema.

total.description: Comments on the item BEFORE the window.

skip_newest.description: How many of the newest comments were skipped.

limit.description: The page size in force; 0 means unlimited, as everywhere else.
